purpose: Add bounded read-only Performance Timing Evidence for exact verified current-Version PCM material: detect descriptive energy-onset candidates and spacing evidence without inventing a musical grid, pocket score, timing defect, or correction authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect exact current-Version timing-event evidence that helps investigate feel and pocket questions while N0TE preserves intentional push/pull and refuses to grade timing without a trusted musical reference.

why_now: Global reselection from stable main compared the unowned AUDIO-01 gaps REQ-SCOPE-073, REQ-SCOPE-074, REQ-SCOPE-121 and REQ-SCOPE-122 against current foundations and parallel ownership. REQ-SCOPE-121 is required, provider-independent, directly useful in Produce/Learn, currently partial, and unclaimed. Existing Creative Diagnosis recognizes groove/pocket/timing only as an artist-declared problem while exact PCM verification already exists, making a descriptive timing-evidence lens a high-value collision-free next slice. Main subsequently advanced through independently verified Windows loopback/profile-response reliability, Artist Career State, and source-bound Capture Opportunity Bank work. Those deltas are disjoint from this receipt, so the exact timing implementation/test blobs are reconstructed atomically onto current main a04edfbbd692a42ab4dab76f1f4f45c3e385255e rather than allowing stale ancestry or governance state to overwrite newer product foundations.
instead_of_what: Do not wait for provider-backed stem separation, collide with the actively owned A/B loudness-bias lane, attempt the much larger reversible audio-to-MIDI translation ladder, or invent a groove grader. Measure only what exact PCM can support truthfully.

implementation_contract.input_truth: Only exact verified managed integer-PCM WAV material attached to the active Song current Version is eligible. Existing Song/Version/Asset fingerprint and source-size bindings are reused and rechecked before evidence return.
implementation_contract.event_truth: Detected candidates are positive short-time energy changes only. A candidate is not asserted to be a note, beat, drum hit, syllable, transient source, bar position, performance mistake, or intentional accent.
implementation_contract.spacing_truth: Candidate count, density, median spacing and robust spacing spread are descriptive evidence only. Without a trusted grid/reference, N0TE does not infer BPM, meter, beat phase, early/late, ahead/behind, swing, tightness, sloppiness, humanization quality, or needed quantization.
implementation_contract.consumer_truth: The normal Song surface names the exact evidence boundary and distinguishes measurement from creative diagnosis hypotheses and artist judgment.
implementation_contract.mutation: Rendering timing evidence creates no audio edit, warp, quantization, DAW/provider action, Version, approval, Learning outcome, preference promotion, or artistic decision.

completion_proof: supported exact PCM current-Version material produces bounded onset-candidate timing evidence through the normal Song consumer path
regular synthetic pulse material produces deterministic candidate spacing evidence within expected tolerance
irregular pulse material changes descriptive spacing spread without being labeled worse, sloppy or incorrect
silent, too-short or insufficient-event material produces an explicit unavailable/insufficient state rather than fabricated timing statistics
same-size byte tampering or changed managed material fails closed before stale timing evidence can surface
consumer copy explicitly rejects beat-grid, tempo, early/late, pocket-quality and correction claims
opening the view leaks no private IDs, managed URIs or local paths and mutates no Song/Version state
existing Engineering Snapshot, Mix Relationships, Creative Diagnosis and Version A/B behavior remain regression-compatible
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the exact head on Linux, Windows and macOS
non_scope: BPM, tempo, meter, beat-grid or beat-phase estimation
early/late, ahead/behind, on/off-grid or swing classification
tight/sloppy, good/bad, correct/incorrect or humanization-quality scoring
note, drum-hit, syllable, performer or transient-source identification
automatic quantization, warp, timing correction or DAW mutation
marking AUDIO-01 DONE or claiming full REQ-SCOPE-121 completion
